description: This file defines the EditTagDialog class, a dialog component for editing or creating tags within an Android application. It manages user input for tag names, checks for existing tags, and interacts with a ViewModel to update or insert tags.

classes.name: EditTagDialog
classes.description: A dialog for editing or creating tags, extending BaseDialog with a specific binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, retrieves the Tag object from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and returns the view binding for the dialog layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the dialog UI based on whether editing an existing tag or creating a new one, sets up button actions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the dialog with an optional Tag argument.
